# or empty, WeaponCombiner falls back to a built-in default set.
#   category — origin | movement | lifetime | firerate | onhit | size | levelup | acceleration | impact
#   variant  — integer enum value within that category:
#                movement: Straight=0 Spiral=1 Fixed=2 Orbital=3 Homing=4 Aimed=5
#                onhit:    Vanish=0 NoChange=1 Reflect=2 Multiply=3 Field=4

#                impact:   Damage=0 Knockback=1 Gather=2 Burn=3 Slow=4 (multi-
#                          select: a weapon may equip several
#                          always-on baseline. amount = effect strength / Burn
#   label    — name shown on the card (ASCII)
#   color    — 0xRRGGBB icon / slot colour (levelup also tints the weapon)
#   amount   — levelup: per-level bump (Damage/Count add, Cooldown
#              multiplies, Speed/Size add). size: uniform scale of the
#              projectile. movement (Orbital): orbit radius in world units
#              (0 = sits on the player and follows). onhit: max hits before
#              fire). acceleration: speed delta per second applied each frame
#              reverse if it crosses zero). Ignored for other categories.
#   duration — lifetime only: projectile lifetime in seconds (how long each
#              shot lives). Cooldown weapons use it
#              (firerate 0) ignores it and stays effectively permanent.
